text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text:
"It's summer! It's festival time!! Let's
get hyped up!!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaay-waaay☆ Is everybody hypeeeed!?
Say waaay!! Waaaaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendees
text_block_list.text: Uwaaahhh....... Yay...-ish...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's with everyone?! It's a
festival, guys?!?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, it's not just that the crowd lacks
energy...
they look totally wiped out, don't they?
Well, it is hot today...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but just for times like this!
I heard they're handing out "Summer
Fatigue Buster Drinks" at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't see anything like that, do
you? Besides...
Whoa, whoa, the festival committee folks
are making a whole lot of noise.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
――What!? The vendor made a delivery
mistake...!?

text_block_list.name: Festival Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The anti-summer heat fatigue drinks
we were
originally planning to hand out aren't
ready yet...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, no wonder all the customers look so
worn out.

text_block_list.name: Festival Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, at this rate, all the guests who came
out for us will...
And the concert isn't until this
evening...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"When in doubt, put your hands up!! Party
people help each other out, right!?
Let's figure this out together with us! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Helios-senpai is totally right. It'd
be so sad if the festival didn't pop off
after all this...
I'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
――Let's see, first we need to bring the
distribution tent materials
and drink ingredients to the venue. Man,
there's quite a lot of it...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, we gotta hand 'em out before everyone
gets totally wiped, right?
Oh, wouldn't it be totally Gucci if we
just brought everything all at once!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I-I don't know, what do you think!? They
said it'd take several whole trucks, so
even for us, moving it all at once might
be rough...!?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right... There's no way there
are many
Umamusume around with that kind of
power...—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"............ THERE YOU AREEEEE!!
HOLD IT RIGHT THEEEEEERE!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So that's what happened—...
Or so she says, Gentile-san."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I kind of barged in on a whim, but...
Do you think Gentile-senpai will help us
out...!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Judging by how things look, it
might be a bit tough... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ――Um, could you at least let me help out?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just dancing on a stage built by others...
Hardly befitting a "Queen," wouldn't you
say?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Through my actions, I will show what it
means to be a reigning "strong one" at the
summit.
—What will you do? Gentil-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ......*chuckle* I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Since you went through the trouble of
offering such a cute provocation...
I suppose I could indulge you to pass the
time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right? Can you drink some
water?
Don't rush, just take it nice and slow."

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp* *gulp*... *Phew*, thank you... nice
big sister...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good girl. Just hang in there a
little longer, okay?
—How does it look, Craft?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's weird! According to the guide,
there's supposed to be a tent handing out
anti-summer-fatigue drinks right here...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh!
Hey, take a look at that...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Is this the right place for the setup?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Carrying such a heavy load while keeping a
cool face...!!
What strength...! Truly worthy of the
'Gentle Dame'!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Shall I bring some for you as
well?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Ngh...! No, thank you...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Gentildonna-senpai, that's incredible...
Were those... materials for a tent you
were carrying?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —I see, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that... what this means?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The seniors are likely handing out drinks
to visitors right now,
doing their best to relieve everyone from
the summer heat—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"We must lend our assistance as well.
To quench the thirst of our guests!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I'll ask my friends to come along too♪

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Woow... The nice big sister looks so cool
now...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mm, that's right.
Cesario is so gentle and cool!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously thanks a bunch, Messiah!
For carrying all of this for us!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, I tried to carry as much as
Gentildonna-senpai, but...
This was all I could manage...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... I don't think you need to worry
about that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Is that everything? Thank you so much,
everyone!
Even though we have a concert this
evening—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um... where should I carry this luggage
to?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? Still-chan, you were helping out
too...!?
I'm sorry, I didn't notice...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please, pay it no mind... Watching
everyone just made me...
unable to stand by and do nothing, that's
all—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Right. Seeing Gentil-san, Cesario-san,
and the others
lending a helping hand with such
strength... I just couldn't help myself——)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(My blood is boiling...! Ahh...!
If only I could run alongside, corner, and
completely devour a "strong one" like
that——)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"(—No... this is so unseemly...!
Anyway, I have to distract myself... and
calm this excitement...)"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right!! Preparations are perf-fect!!
Time to kick off the Non-Stop Drink
Distribution Extravaganzaaa!!
